name: What compensation can I seek after a rideshare accident?
description: You can seek compensation for medical expenses, lost wages, property damage, and pain and suffering after a rideshare accident.

mainEntity.name: What compensation can I seek after a rideshare accident?

acceptedAnswer.text: After a rideshare accident, you may be able to seek compensation for various damages. These can include economic damages such as medical expenses (past and future), lost wages (past and future), property damage, and rehabilitation costs. Non-economic damages may also be pursued, which include pain and suffering, emotional distress, and loss of enjoyment of life. The specific types and amounts of compensation depend on the severity of your injuries, the impact on your life, and the specifics of the accident.
